facts.fact: FrontPage Africa reports that Jerry Nyantee Wrotto was arrested in September 2026 (days before the 21 September report, exact date not given) and held for allegedly posting AI-generated nude images and a video of Vice President Koung claiming he was screened at Brussels Airport, under the Cybercrime Act of 2025 (cyber-harassment/cyberbullying); the Vice President asked for his release and the document gives no release or court outcome.

The Press Union of Liberia, through its president Julius Kanubah, warned that reopening the 2019 KAK Act through the proposed 2026 draft Protection from Gender-Based Online Abuse and Harassment Act could erode protections won by journalists and citizens, and argued online harassment should be handled under the Cybercrime Act instead; the document gives no month.
facts.system: Protection from Gender-Based Online Abuse and Harassment Act (draft)

facts.fact: The document states that the 2019 Kamara Abdullah Kamara (KAK) Act decriminalized speech offences such as sedition and criminal libel against the President; it is given as background, with no month and no statement of who passed it.

systems.owner: Government of Liberia (signed by President Boakai)
